Tears Seven Times (abbreviated to T7T) is an American vegan straight edge metalcore solo project from Atlanta, Georgia. It’s only member, Sid K., gets influence from 90’s-2000’s melodic metalcore bands like Prayer For Cleansing and Undying, additionally gothic influences by Paradise Lost and Type O Negative. T7T is the first musical act to be self-labeled as “gothic metalcore”, whether or not this is true is arguable due to some metalcore bands having a similar style before.

Laucean is a Belgian artist who creates a fusion of metal and shoegaze.

His debut album "Ces êtres oubliés", released on August 31, 2025, explores themes of ocean conservation, animal rights, and grief.

For fans of Alcest, Møl, or Les Discrets, Laucean invites listeners to dive into a world beneath the waves — where beauty meets darkness.
